title: Ambrook, which offers accounting software, raised a $30M Series B led by Lachy Groom as it expands beyond farming into trucking, construction, and real estate (Alex Konrad/Upstarts Media)
summary: Alex Konrad / Upstarts Media: Ambrook, which offers accounting software, raised a $30M Series B led by Lachy Groom as it expands beyond farming into trucking, construction, and real estate — In the early days of her startup, Ambrook, CEO Mackenzie Burnett and a small team would hop on a plane - then often take a bumpy drive …
